'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]]
***An overnight [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[missile]] and [[Drone warfare|drone attack]] on [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]], kills three people, injures 49 others and causes fires across the capital with multiple districts targeted. At least 2,000 homes lose power, according to the [[Kyiv City State Administration]]. At least 407 drones and 45 missiles are launched in total. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-drones-attack-kyiv-witnesses-report-explosions-fire-2025-06-05/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-putin-zelenskyy-trump-80c8984bc2e52da0212da4e0d4cf8220 (AP)]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***Widespread [[power outage]]s are reported in [[Ternopil]] after several [[cruise missile]]s hit energy infrastructure supplying the city. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4001254-ternopil-region-under-massive-russias-attack-multiple-hits-reported-rma.html (Ukrinform)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Deportation of Kilmar Abrego Garcia]]
**Kilmar Abrego Garcia returns to the [[United States]], two months after being mistakenly deported to [[El Salvador]] and spending time at the [[Terrorism Confinement Center|CECOT]] prison. He now faces criminal charges in [[Tennessee]] for allegedly transporting [[Undocumented immigrant population of the United States|undocumented migrants]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/mistakenly-deported-kilmar-abrego-garcia-back-us-face/story?id=121333122 (ABC News)]
